songs.title: A New Beginning
songs.body:
I feel it lifting all my being
the sound is rising from within
My voice is singing loud and strong
inviting you to sing along
The waves are sweeping all the pain
We're breaking free from every chain
at last we are answering the call
'cause you and I we are one with all

The golden light was always there
We only had to truly dare
To walk the path and make it home
loving all and chanting Om

This ancient force is all around
it's made of light, of love and sound
connecting all that's near and far
reminding us of who we are
The rhythm flows and breaks the night
Unfolds the truth, reveals the light
In cosmic dance we rise and fall
'cause you and I we are one with all

The golden light was always there
We only had to truly dare
To walk the path and make it home
loving all and chanting Om

songs.title: Blessed You Are
songs.body:
[Verse 1]
I know your searching too
Another way, another day, another mood,
But even your mistakes
Are there to teach you how to fix whatever breaks
No need to clench your fist
The little things risk to get lost into the mist
Look around
There so much life and treasures coming from the ground

[Chorus]
Blessed you are
When you desire
What you've already got
No need to travel far
You are your rainbow
And your own golden pot

[Verse 2]
Feel the heat
Your heart is beating as you're dancing on your feet
Spread your wings
There are no limits to what the universe can bring
Hold my hand
The best adventures are the ones you never plan
Welcome home
Do you remember that you are never here alone

[Chorus]
Blessed you are
When you desire
What you've already got
No need to travel far
You are your rainbow
And your own golden pot

songs.title: Can You See the Light Within
songs.body:
Can you see the light within
Showing the way to your destiny
All you are is energy
Trying to recover its memory
Let your soul awaken and rise
Believe in yourself and open your eyes
If you are waiting this is the sign
Time to open your heart, together we shine

I've always looked outside of me
Searching for serenity
Waiting for some entity
To give me an identity
Until I felt the eternity
Beyond my own mortality
I'm part of the divinity
Existing throughout infinity

The source of all prosperity
Is your own positivity
Looking for opportunity
To turn into possibility
Welcoming creativity
Sharing your ability
Letting your vitality
Take you towards your victory

Living in duality
Seeking spirituality
Working with integrity
For peace in its totality
The roots of our community
Are peace, respect and unity
Truthful solidarity
And everyone's self authority

songs.title: Cloud Animals
songs.body:
[Verse 1]
I'm lying in the grass beneath the open sky,
watching as the animals drift slowly by.
A lion made of vapor lets out a silent roar,
a whale swims through the heavens like it's done before.
I used to only see the clouds and nothing more,
but now I understand what all this light is for.

[Chorus]
Look up and let your mind create,
the life you dream is never too late.
You hold the brush, you paint the scene,
the world becomes whatever you believe.
What you imagine starts to grow,
you are the dreamer, you make it so.

[Verse 2]
A dragon breathes its fire through the afternoon,
a butterfly of silver dances with the moon.
The universe is canvas and your thoughts are paint,
turning all your fears to flowers, all your doubt to grace.
The world bends gently towards the vision that you hold,
so let the story of your life be daring and be bold.

[Chorus]
Look up and let your mind create,
the life you dream is never too late.
You hold the brush, you paint the scene,
the world becomes whatever you believe.
What you imagine starts to grow,
you are the dreamer, you make it so.

[Bridge]
Every cloud was once a thought that drifted through your mind,
every joy was born from something you were brave enough to find.
The universe is listening to everything you say,
so speak your vision into life and watch it find its way.

[Chorus]
Look up and let your mind create,
the life you dream is never too late.
You hold the brush, you paint the scene,
the world becomes whatever you believe.
What you imagine starts to grow,
you are the dreamer, you make it so.

songs.title: Come to Wanderlust
songs.body:
Come with us to Wanderlust tonight
Let's all come together into the light
Close your eyes and feel the spark
Shining bright into the park
Of a thousand loving hearts beating as one

Come with us to Wanderlust today
Let's all flow together and find the way
Can you feel our connection
Can you see your own direction
It's the true north calling you to find yourself

Come with us to Wanderlust once more
Let's all dance to the music and hit the floor
Stomp your feet onto the ground
Hold my hand and make a sound
Chanting om and elevating each other up

songs.title: Endless Love
songs.body:
Searching for the light within, ready for the embrace,
Welcoming the essence, and the blessing of our grace.
And from the darkest shadows, we'll always rise above,
As our soul illuminates our path with endless love.

walking through the madness, we are searching for the light,
For that flame within us, that guide us through the night.
Seeking truth and wisdom and the radiance from within,
step by step a journey of a new life begins.

With every step we take, we get closer to the source,
following the beacon, that's guiding our course.
and even in the scariest storm we never lose our way,
nurtured and protected from the light that never sway.

accepting our nature and stepping in the light
awakening our strength and showing our might.
For all of us are vessels of a radiant divine,
reflected in the universe and it's wonderful design.

Searching for the light within, ready for the embrace,
Welcoming the essence, and the blessing of our grace.
And from the darkest shadows, we'll always rise above,
As our soul illuminates our path with endless love.

songs.title: Everything Will Go My Way
songs.body:
Running free, hands into the wind
Finding guidance from the voice within
Feel the sunshine glowing on my skin
I am ready to let my life begin

I don't need to see the ending
I don't need a map
I am lucky every moment
Of my life
I am loved and protected
Blessed from up above
And I know everything
Will go my way

Cloudless skies above the open road
I leave behind the weight I used to hold
Every step feels lighter than before
Getting further from all I've ever known

I don't need to see the ending
I don't need a map
I am lucky every moment
Of my life
I am loved and protected
Blessed from up above
And I know everything
Will go my way

Heart wide open, standing in the light
I spread my wings I am ready for the flight
Every fear is fading out of sight
Diving in I know I'll be alright

I don't need to see the ending
I don't need a map
I am lucky every moment
Of my life
I am loved and protected
Blessed from up above
And I know everything
Will go my way

songs.title: I'm Proud of You
songs.body:
You made it through, you're safe and sound,
You faced the storm and always tried to hold your ground.
In a crowded room, you tried to explain,
Your heart was out but no one ever saw your pain.
You held your breath, you hid your fears,
You carried hope while diving deep inside your tears.
The nights were long, your mind would race,
But I can see the darkness never stole your grace.

And if I never told you, then let me say it now,
You turned your pain to strength, without you even knowing how.
Every weight you carry and every step you take,
Every scar is proof your soul can bend but never break.

And I am proud of you
For all the times you were afraid but you went through
And you are not alone
There is no need to face this always on your own
And we will find a way
Walk through the darkness of the night into the day

You thought that help was for the weak,
So you stayed silent while the world was turning bleak.
You carried all the weight alone,
Forgetting hearts were never meant to turn to stone.
You hid the cracks behind your smile,
You masked your demons but it worked only for a while.
The healing starts when you let it go,
Letting patiently the light inside you grow.

And if I never told you, then let me say it now,
You turned your pain to strength, without you even knowing how.
Every weight you carry and every step you take,
Every scar is proof your soul can bend but never break.

And I am proud of you
For all the times you were afraid but you went through
And you are not alone
There is no need to face this always on your own
And we will find a way
Walk through the darkness of the night into the day

songs.title: In the Silence
songs.body:
Title: In the Silence
Language: English
Meter: 8 syllables, AABB couplets
Theme: Silence as a gift for self-knowledge — the space where we hear our own truth

Chords — Verses: G — Em — C — D (last line: G → E → Am)
Chords — Chorus: Am — Dm — E — Am

[Verse 1]
I used to feel an empty space
A misty shadow on my face
My heart was heavy in my chest
I could not sleep I could not rest
My mind was racing all the time
From thought to thought from rhyme to rhyme
Until a silence never seen before
One day came knocking on my door

[Chorus]
In the silence I can finally see
The person that I'm meant to be
In the silence, in the deep
My soul can rest my mind can sleep
In the silence I can embrace
All my darkness and all my grace
In the silence I feel at home
'Cause I remember I'm never alone

[Verse 2]
I felt the whole world in my soul
No need to fight, to be in control
I'm just a tiny little kite
Among another million in the light
A weaving thread in a canopy
A little droplet in the sea
I am a mess and a masterpiece
Sitting silently in peace

[Chorus]
In the silence I can finally see
The person that I'm meant to be
In the silence, in the deep
My soul can rest my mind can sleep
In the silence I can embrace
All my darkness and all my grace
In the silence I feel at home
'Cause I remember I'm never alone

[Verse 3]
If sometimes you're lost like me
You are feeling lost, down on your knees
When the future looks grim and dark
And you need help to light your spark
Listen closely and you will find
In a quiet place inside your mind
Where all the troubles of the day
Are just a memory far away

[Chorus]
In the silence I can finally see
The person that I'm meant to be
In the silence, in the deep
My soul can rest my mind can sleep
In the silence I can embrace
All my darkness and all my grace
In the silence I feel at home
'Cause I remember I'm never alone

songs.title: Little One
songs.body:
[Verse 1]
I see you in the corner trying hard to disappear,
six years old and learning that the world felt cold and unclear.
You told yourself you were extra, that your presence was a weight,
that no one really needed you, that you had come too late.
You made yourself so small that you could barely hear your name,
not knowing you were never, ever meant to play a smaller game.

[Chorus]
I am so proud of you,
without the boy you were I never would have made it through.
You were never extra, never in the way,
you are the whole reason I am standing here today.
Thank you for the light you kept when all was dark,
thank you for the music living in your heart.

[Verse 2]
The silence that surrounded you became a place to sing,
you didn't know the gift you held or all that it would bring.
A melody was growing in the quiet of your chest,
reminding you that being here was always for the best.
Each note you hummed alone at night became a road back home,
a song you'd one day give to all who felt they were alone.

[Chorus]
I am so proud of you,
without the boy you were I never would have made it through.
You were never extra, never in the way,
you are the whole reason I am standing here today.
Thank you for the light you kept when all was dark,
thank you for the music living in your heart.

[Bridge]
I know you asked the mirror if there was a reason why,
I know the nights were heavy and you tried so hard not to cry.
But here I am, I'm standing in the answer to your prayer,
everything I am today was built because you dared to stay.

[Chorus]
I am so proud of you,
without the boy you were I never would have made it through.
You were never extra, never in the way,
you are the whole reason I am standing here today.
Thank you for the light you kept when all was dark,
thank you for the music living in your heart.

songs.title: Luna Luna Io Ti Chiamo
songs.body:
Luna Luna io ti chiamo,
sali in cielo piano piano.
Luna Luna stai vicino,
e illumina il mio cammino.
Luna Luna misteriosa,
porta luce in ogni cosa.
Luna Luna sul sentiero
mostra il bello, il giusto e il vero.

Quando il buio avvolge il mondo
e sembra di toccare il fondo.
Guardo in alto e vedo il viso
della luna e il suo sorriso.
Sembra che mi voglia dire:
"Ora è il tempo di fluire.
Lascia andare il tuo passato,
ringraziando ciò che è stato."

Quando il sole va a dormire
cerco luce all'imbrunire.
Chiedo solo una fiammella,
a lei che splende così bella.
Lei mi dice: "Nel tuo cuore
arde il fuoco dell'amore.
Allontana la paura
e brilla nella notte oscura."

Quando trovo la mia strada
e la nebbia si dirada.
Mi ricordo del suo aiuto
e con grazia la saluto.
"Grazie a te che mi hai guarito,
ascoltato e accudito.
Sempre io ti sarò grato,
per avermi liberato."

Shabat shalom

songs.title: Shaman Bay
songs.body:
Prendi il vino e canta con noi
Fatti un bel bagno se lo vuoi
se sei stressato è tutto ok
fai un salto a Shaman bay
Shaman bay
ti aspettiamo a shaman bay

c'è una spiaggia molto speciale
ai piedi dell'aso, sul litorale
dove poeti, pirati e sciamani
da tutti i colli marchigiani
si trovano spesso per festeggiare
per stare insieme vicino al mare
passando il tempo con gli amici
scambiandosi consigli e buoni auspici

in questo spazio costruito col legno,
con tanto amore e con tanto impegno
tutto ordinato e molto pulito
sempre protetto e accudito
si canta in coro, si beve e si balla
si prende un po' il sole e si gioca a palla
qui le serate non finiscono mai
se vieni anche un secondo poi non te ne vai

se passi in bici o mentre passeggi
fermati un attimo molla gli ormeggi
fai una pausa e conosci la gente
in questa atmosfera così accogliente
nessuna anima qui è sconosciuta
ogni persona è benvenuta
se non ci fosse non so come farei
grazie al cielo c'è shaman bay

songs.title: Shine Again
songs.body:
Waves are calling from afar,
Reminding us of who we are.
Diving deep but reaching high,
Towards the sun into the sky.
Dancing barefoot in the trees,
Singing softly in the breeze.
Breathing life into the wild,
Awakening our inner child.

So much more than fading bodies,
Broken dreams and good old stories.
We are made of light, of love and sound
We are torn and mended, lost and found.
Hold me close, I hear the calling,
Through the night, the stars are falling.
Through the silence, through the rain,
I find my light to shine again.

In my heart, I start to see,
The truth that shines inside of me.
With every step, I must be strong,
To find the place where I belong.
Ancient wisdom guides my way,
The night dissolves into the day.
No more fear, no more fights,
Only morning shining lights.

So much more than fading bodies,
Broken dreams and good old stories.
We are made of light, of love and sound
We are torn and mended, lost and found.
Hold me close, I hear the calling,
Through the night, the stars are falling.
Through the silence, through the rain,
I find my light to shine again.

songs.title: Tell Me a Story
songs.body:
Tell me a story sing it like a lullaby
Whisper it softly so I that can close my eyes
Like a thousand fireflies into the darkness bring the light
Don't be afraid because I know we'll always make it through the night
A million times or more I fell with my face into the ground
Just like a lonely tree in a forest no one ever heard the sound
no matter what I've got myself back on my feet every single time
Shaking it off and moving forward putting a together another rhyme

Stay close to me
Let's fly together above the summit of the highest tree
We are finally free
to be the purest form of whatever we choose to be

Call onto my name so I can open up my eyes
I need you to wake me from the slumber and to free me from my ties
There's nothing in life we should ever dread be joyful and open and brave instead
This journey's still long so many miles to tread so much to be learned so many words to be said
I'm doing my best to remember and to help you never forget
To cherish our time and every breath we take, every song that we sang and every person we met
every tear that we lost and every smile that we give
every time we choose love and every time we forgive

Stay close to me
Let's fly together above the summit of the highest tree
We are finally free
to be the purest form of whatever we choose to be

songs.title: The Garden
songs.body:
I don't chase butterflies no more,
don't ask myself what i'm living for.
I'm planting flowers, one by one,
And sit beneath the setting sun.
I'm tired of running and fall behind
instead i found my peace of mind
here in the garden where i stand
not meant for others to understand

And in the garden that I grow,
The seeds of love begin to show.
I feel the essence of my soul,
the flowing life that makes me whole.
Not all I want will come my way,
Not every dream is meant to stay.
But when i bloom in truth and grace,
What's meant for me will find this place.

The winds may shift, the seasons change,
what is familiar will be strange.
No need to chase or beg or fight,
I'm dancing here with my delight.
And if no butterflies appear,
There's still a garden growing here.
I don't need glory, I don't need fame,
those meant to find me will know my name.

And in the garden that I grow,
The seeds of love begin to show.
I feel the essence of my soul,
the flowing life that makes me whole.
Not all I want will come my way,
Not every dream is meant to stay.
But when i bloom in truth and grace,
What's meant for me will find this place.

songs.title: Walking Towards the Light
songs.body:
I'm alone in the dark
With my fears taking over me
I am struggling to survive
Just to find a way to be
Staring at the ceiling from my bed
With the voices in my head
Telling me I'm not enough
To give up, run away and cry
Telling me there is no hope
That I shouldn't even try

But then I listen to my heart
And I remember I'm alive
I can make it on my own
I can find the will to thrive
To be brave in what I choose
As I'm walking towards the light

I can feel it in my soul
I can feel it in my skin
There's a fire burning up
Shining endlessly within
Giving me the strength to carry on
Giving me some light before the dawn
Reminding me my journey has no end
To let go as I ascend

So I get rid of what is old
All my pain and all my fears
And I begin to elevate
As my sadness disappears
Now the darkness fades away
I have made it through the night
I forgive myself and smile
As I'm walking towards the light

Now the sun is high above
Shining light upon my way
Filling me with hope and joy
For the dawn of another day
I promise to myself I'll do my best
I'll listen to my heart beating in my chest
I'll always give best that I can give
Helping others to believe

There is no more need to fight
I left my demons in the past
There's no more obstacles ahead
No more shadows to contrast
I am flowing in the sun
Everything around is bright
I can feel already home
As I'm walking towards the light

songs.title: What I Learned
songs.body:
I was dissolving in the light when suddenly I heard a sound
a gentle voice was whispering inside of me an all around
it's been a long and weary road, I've waited years for your return
so tell me son, along the way what are the lessons that you've learned
you said to love my enemies, 'cause hatred turns free men to slaves
the very worst of them was me, so that's the first one I forgave
you cannot heal by hiding darkness, burying sorrow, ignoring pain
but when you let your heart forgive, you'll find the strength to love again

if you can keep your mind in silence truth will always rise
the beauty that you see around it's painted through your eyes
the words we speak about another only tell us who we are
doesn't mean their cross is lighter just because they carry it far
never climb a mountain to show the world that you can shine
you are already one with all, you are a part of the divine
reach the summit not for glory, but to see the entire world
and these are just a few of all the lessons that I learned

the road to heaven feels like hell, the one to hell like paradise
purposeless men chase the pleasure of the devil in disguise
when the wait takes a little longer, then the prize is even higher
chasing after many things will never bring what you desire
don't blame the one who lost his way but tries to lead you anyway
an eagle born inside a cage will rather walk than fly away
for what we think is what we are and what we are is how we act
cats who dream to roar like lions don't go chasing after rats

if you can keep your mind in silence truth will always rise
the beauty that you see around it's painted through your eyes
the words we speak about another only tell us who we are
doesn't mean their cross is lighter just because they carry it far
never climb a mountain to show the world that you can shine
you are already one with all, you are a part of the divine
reach the summit not for glory, but to see the entire world
and these are just a few of all the lessons that I learned

Raise your words and not your voice, let the rain make flowers grow
be a warrior in a garden, not a gardener in a war
right is right if no one does it wrong is wrong even when all do
be compassionate with others, it's the first time they are living too
don't judge others by their actions if you judge yours by intent
if you are not grateful for your life then you can never be content
you must carry your own water and learn the value of every drop
even years of sunshine cannot turn deserts into crops

if you can keep your mind in silence truth will always rise
the beauty that you see around it's painted through your eyes
the words we speak about another only tell us who we are
doesn't mean their cross is lighter just because they carry it far
never climb a mountain to show the world that you can shine
you are already one with all, you are a part of the divine
reach the summit not for glory, but to see the entire world
and these are just a few of all the lessons that I learned

songs.title: You Can Always Count on Me
songs.body:
When we first have met under the branches of an old tree
Our souls were young and our spirits free
We were seeking each other with a spark in our eyes
Like the stars at dusk firing up into the sky
Walking through the forest across the river and by the streams
Facing every adventure we live the life of our dreams

And I can always count on you and you can count on me
Cause you know I'll be there for you and you'll be there for me
And forever we will stand as one in the middle of the storm
Cause our love burns like a fire and will always keep us warm
And together we will sail across every ocean and every sea
Cause you know I was made for you and you were made for me

For every seed we planted thousands flowers have come and bloomed
Surrounding us with colors and with ravishing perfumes
This world we have created cannot ever be torn apart
Cause everything we did together came from our heart
And we will smile again and forever until our hair is white
Remembering the songs we sang holding each other tight

And I can always count on you and you can count on me
Cause you know I'll be there for you and you'll be there for me
And forever we will stand as one in the middle of the storm
Cause our love burns like a fire and will always keep us warm
And together we will sail across every ocean and every sea
Cause you know I was made for you and you were made for me

No matter how much time goes by how many seasons pass
We'll always play together rolling happily in the grass
Like children building castles in the sand washed by the tide
When we are tired we will take a rest close by each other's side
And no matter how hard it gets we will always make it through
Cause I know you are in love with me and I'm in love with you

And I can always count on you and you can count on me
Cause you know I'll be there for you and you'll be there for me
And forever we will stand as one in the middle of the storm
Cause our love burns like a fire and will always keep us warm
And together we will sail across every ocean and every sea
Cause you know I was made for you and you were made for me

songs.title: You Must Be an Angel
songs.body:
We've known each other for a million years
And we have shared so many joys and tears
I am so grateful for the time together
And I am sure our love will last forever
In all my life I've never met somebody like you
Healing my wounds to get me up again like new

You tell stories of wisdom, compassion and love
You fly high like an eagle, but you are sweet like a dove
The magic sound of your voice is gentle and pure
And there's no illness its wonders ain't able to cure
You bring light to the darkness and joy to the spirit
You are an infinite being and your soul has no limit

Every time that you smile you bring joy to the place
I feel blessed and inspired when I look at your face
You turn rain into sunshine when you laugh from your heart
And I can trust that our souls will be never apart
You grow faith into me and you make me believe
That with you by my side there's nothing I can't achieve

So you must be an angel, a creature of light
Shining bright like a star, guiding me through the night
So you must be an angel, singing with grace
And I find my redemption in your loving embrace
So you must be an angel healing sorrow and pain
And I'll be always with you dancing under the rain
So you must be an angel the most wonderful one
And I'll be always with you dancing under the sun
